description: This file defines classes related to security and scanning in the SuiteCRM project. It includes classes for security operations, file content scanning, handling include and require statements, and managing multiple scanners.

classes.name: SugarSecure
classes.description: Handles displaying scan results, saving results to a file, and initiating directory scans for PHP files.

classes.name: ScanFileIncludes
classes.description: Extends SugarSecure to specifically scan PHP files for include/require and fopen/file_get_contents statements.

classes.name: SugarSecureManager
classes.description: Manages multiple scanner objects, running scans, displaying results, and saving all scanner outputs.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the stored results as HTML table rows.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the scan results to a specified file.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Recursively scans directories for PHP files.

methods.name: scanContents
methods.description: Analyzes the contents of a file to find include, require, fopen, and file_get_contents statements.
